description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee skill search parameters in the HR system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a property for employee number with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee allowed skills, with properties and methods to set search criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter criterion.
